annotation_note: Annotated before any model run. Gold criterion outcomes were authored by the builder. Gold readiness was derived from those outcomes by the deterministic pathway scorer in tools.checklist_scorer, plus code validation and policy version checks, not by a model. Only 3 cases derive from published case reports, paraphrased in short form with source and license. The other 27 are structured test fixtures, clearly labeled, not real patient notes and not presented as real. This set was not used to optimize the agent, because no model run had happened when it was written.

cases.clinical_note: 13-year-old girl with low back pain after a fall during sports three months earlier, tingling over the posterior bilateral lower limbs, straight leg raise positive at 50 degrees on the left and 60 degrees on the right, no neuro deficit, no bowel or bladder involvement, and no significant improvement with conservative treatment. MRI showed disc desiccation with diffuse disc bulge at L4-L5 causing severe compromise of bilateral lateral recesses.
cases.annotation_rationale: Radiculopathy needs objective motor or reflex changes, which are not documented, so LUM-01 is uncertain, not met. Conservative duration is not stated, so LUM-02 is uncertain, not met. Atypical adolescent surgical case, not a typical adult approval example.
cases.gold_rationale: Pathway LUM-A is uncertain; a human must resolve the uncertain criteria.

cases.clinical_note: 18-year-old male with left knee pain and mechanical symptoms, locking and catching, for 2 years, medial joint line tenderness, range of motion 0 to 130 degrees, left knee radiographs unremarkable. MRI confirmed a discoid medial meniscus with a horizontal oblique tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Arthroscopic saucerization with a 5-mm rim remaining and meniscal repair were performed.
cases.annotation_rationale: Discoid meniscus is extremely rare. No Kellgren-Lawrence grade and no physical therapy are documented, so those criteria are missing.
cases.gold_rationale: No pathway fully met. Non-met criteria: KNE-02, KNE-04.

cases.clinical_note: 33-year-old woman with Crohn disease confirmed on ileocolonoscopy with severe active ileocolitis. Systemic corticosteroids gave rapid improvement, with relapse during tapering. Infliximab 5 mg/kg was given at week 0, week 1, and week 4, then 5 mg/kg every 8 weeks. Both ileocolitis and myositis were quiescent at 20 months.
cases.annotation_rationale: Dosing weeks 0, 1, and 4 do not match the subset criterion weeks 0, 2, and 6, so BIO-04 is not_met. No gastroenterologist prescriber and no TB screening are stated, so those are missing. License is non-commercial only.
cases.gold_rationale: No pathway fully met. Non-met criteria: BIO-02, BIO-04, BIO-05.
